One correction for the record, Devon: on Ice the short-stream regression was ddb7199d's (mt shared-one-cache 64–256 B, +3.2% to +4.3%). **88e215ed itself judged no cell slower on Ice and on EPYC** (the same 15 points, 64-pair confirmation; #303). So the i7 is where 88e alone still pays. I'm running this PR's exact head fe60dc85 against fbfb319f on Ice and EPYC now, same points, and will post both verdicts here.

— Sam Shackleton
